prompt: The game paused in Manila. When play restarted, the referee said us we only had thirty seconds left.
answer: The game paused in Manila. When play restarted, the referee told us we only had thirty seconds left.
accepted_answers: The game paused in Manila. When play restarted, the referee told us we only had thirty seconds left.
The game paused in Manila. When play restarted, the referee told us that we only had thirty seconds left.
The game paused in Manila. When play restarted, the referee said to us we only had thirty seconds left.
The game paused in Manila. When play restarted, the referee said to us that we only had thirty seconds left.
explanation_ru: После глагола say нельзя ставить прямое дополнение без предлога (said us — частая ошибка). Когда указан адресат, используется tell + кому (told us) или say to + кому.

prompt: Our photos had turned green. From Tallinn, Kadri emailed to explain that the new update ___ the bug.
explanation_ru: Глагол ввода (emailed to explain) стоит в прошедшем времени, поэтому действие, завершившееся раньше, сдвигается в Past Perfect (had fixed). Оставлять Present Perfect (has fixed) здесь ошибочно.

prompt: On a Budapest tram, an old man said to the driver, "My card isn't working." → The old man told the driver …
answer: The old man told the driver his card wasn't working.
accepted_answers: The old man told the driver his card wasn't working.
The old man told the driver that his card wasn't working.
The old man told the driver his card was not working.
The old man told the driver that his card was not working.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи после told местоимение my меняется на his, а Present Continuous (isn't working) сдвигается в Past Continuous (wasn't working).

prompt: Sofía's bag was huge. She told the driver she is going to the sea.
answer: Sofía's bag was huge. She told the driver she was going to the sea.
accepted_answers: Sofía's bag was huge. She told the driver she was going to the sea.
Sofía's bag was huge. She told the driver that she was going to the sea.
explanation_ru: В рассказе о прошлом после told глагол в придаточном сдвигается назад: вместо is going нужно использовать Past Continuous (was going).

prompt: In our study room, Lars closed his maths book: "I'm too tired to study."
options: Lars told me he is too tired to study.
Lars said me he was too tired to study.
Lars told me he was too tired to study.
Lars told me I was too tired to study.
explanation_ru: При пересказе в прошлом местоимение I меняется на he, глагол am сдвигается в was, а с адресатом (me) используется глагол told, а не said.

prompt: The deadline was at five. Tessa told her manager she was finishing the poster for the client. → Tessa said to her manager, …
answer: Tessa said to her manager, "I'm finishing the poster for the client."
accepted_answers: Tessa said to her manager, "I'm finishing the poster for the client."
Tessa said to her manager, "I am finishing the poster for the client."
explanation_ru: При переводе из косвенной речи в прямую местоимение she возвращается в I, а Past Continuous (was finishing) — обратно в Present Continuous (am finishing).

prompt: We finished our Quito art project and flew home. Before it began, the coordinator warned us we were starting ___ at six.
explanation_ru: При пересказе из другого места и времени слова here и tomorrow меняются на there и the next day. Оставлять хотя бы одно из них без изменения в таком контексте ошибочно.

prompt: My cousin lives in Toronto. She wrote in our family chat and asked was the old photo app closing down.
answer: My cousin lives in Toronto. She wrote in our family chat and asked if the old photo app was closing down.
accepted_answers: My cousin lives in Toronto. She wrote in our family chat and asked if the old photo app was closing down.
My cousin lives in Toronto. She wrote in our family chat and asked whether the old photo app was closing down.
explanation_ru: В косвенном общем вопросе обязательно нужен союз if или whether и прямой порядок слов (подлежащее перед глаголом): asked if the old photo app was closing down.

prompt: At a phone repair shop in Lagos, the technician warned me that everyone in the market was saying the brand ___ making spare parts before winter.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о будущем действии в пересказе от прошлого (warned, was saying), поэтому will сдвигается в would. Оставлять will stop в прошедшем контексте — типичная ошибка.

prompt: Someone trapped my car in a Mexico City garage. Later, the van driver calmly denied to block the exit.
answer: Someone trapped my car in a Mexico City garage. Later, the van driver calmly denied blocking the exit.
accepted_answers: Someone trapped my car in a Mexico City garage. Later, the van driver calmly denied blocking the exit.
Someone trapped my car in a Mexico City garage. Later, the van driver calmly denied having blocked the exit.
explanation_ru: После глагола deny используется герундий (глагол с -ing), а не инфинитив с to: denied blocking, а не denied to block.

prompt: At lunch in Warsaw, Marek asked me why was our physics teacher leaving.
answer: At lunch in Warsaw, Marek asked me why our physics teacher was leaving.
accepted_answers: At lunch in Warsaw, Marek asked me why our physics teacher was leaving.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе используется прямой порядок слов (подлежащее перед глаголом): why our physics teacher was leaving, а не why was our physics teacher leaving.

prompt: At Auckland airport, two travellers read the screen. One shouted, "Our flight to Sydney is cancelled!" → One traveller shouted that …
answer: One traveller shouted that their flight to Sydney was cancelled.
accepted_answers: One traveller shouted that their flight to Sydney was cancelled.
explanation_ru: При переводе в косвенную речь от третьего лица our меняется на their, а настоящее время is cancelled сдвигается в прошедшее was cancelled.

prompt: During a visit to a Kyoto garden, a gardener told two students, "The new stone fountain will be switched on here tomorrow."
options: The gardener told the students the new stone fountain will be switched on there the next day.
The gardener told the students the new stone fountain would be switched on here tomorrow.
The gardener said the students the new stone fountain would be switched on there the next day.
The gardener told the students the new stone fountain would be switched on there the next day.
explanation_ru: После told в прошедшем времени will меняется на would, а указатели места и времени here и tomorrow переходят в there и the next day.

prompt: While I was browsing an antique shop in Istanbul, one assistant whispered that the tall mirror in the corner had once belonged to an opera singer.
answer: While I was browsing an antique shop in Istanbul, one assistant whispered that the tall mirror in the corner had once belonged to an opera singer.
accepted_answers: While I was browsing an antique shop in Istanbul, one assistant whispered that the tall mirror in the corner had once belonged to an opera singer.
explanation_ru: В этом предложении нет ошибки: после глагола whispered в прошедшем времени более ранний факт из прошлого верно передан через Past Perfect (had once belonged).

prompt: Sanne streams live from Amsterdam. Before her break, she mentioned that she ___ her weekly show to Fridays, though nothing was certain.
explanation_ru: Модальный глагол might в косвенной речи остаётся без изменений и передаёт неуверенность (nothing was certain), а частица to после него не ставится.

prompt: When a Scottish farmer reported his missing shopping at the village hall, the police officer asked him how did a white goat get into his kitchen.
answer: When a Scottish farmer reported his missing shopping at the village hall, the police officer asked him how a white goat had got into his kitchen.
accepted_answers: When a Scottish farmer reported his missing shopping at the village hall, the police officer asked him how a white goat had got into his kitchen.
When a Scottish farmer reported his missing shopping at the village hall, the police officer asked him how a white goat got into his kitchen.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе вспомогательный глагол did убирается, а порядок слов становится прямым: how a white goat had got (или got), а не how did a white goat get.

prompt: A shop owner in Brno says the broken street light ___ off every night.
explanation_ru: Когда глагол ввода стоит в настоящем времени (says), сдвиг времён не нужен: регулярное действие в настоящем остаётся в Present Simple (goes).

prompt: A huge storm was heading for the island. Two fruit sellers warned us to not leave our bikes outside on Friday.
answer: A huge storm was heading for the island. Two fruit sellers warned us not to leave our bikes outside on Friday.
accepted_answers: A huge storm was heading for the island. Two fruit sellers warned us not to leave our bikes outside on Friday.
explanation_ru: Отрицательная частица not ставится перед частицей to, а не после неё: warned us not to leave, а не warned us to not leave.

prompt: Nobody in Accra had seen an official note. Even so, everyone was saying the exam had been moved to the sports hall. → Everyone was saying, …
answer: Everyone was saying, "The exam has been moved to the sports hall."
accepted_answers: Everyone was saying, "The exam has been moved to the sports hall."
Everyone was saying, "The exam was moved to the sports hall."
explanation_ru: При переходе из косвенной речи в прямую Past Perfect (had been moved) возвращается в Present Perfect (has been moved) или Past Simple (was moved).

prompt: Kabelo pointed at an old bike and said our chemistry teacher lives next door.
answer: Kabelo pointed at an old bike and said our chemistry teacher lives next door.
accepted_answers: Kabelo pointed at an old bike and said our chemistry teacher lives next door.
explanation_ru: В этом предложении нет ошибки: если факт остаётся верным и сейчас (преподаватель по-прежнему живёт рядом), после said допустимо сохранить Present Simple (lives).

prompt: In a Bangkok bank, the guard told us the manager ___ in one hour.
explanation_ru: После глагола told в прошедшем времени будущее действие с will сдвигается в would: would come back, а не will come back.

prompt: The new intern in Geneva dropped a coffee tray when a senior translator casually remarked, "Our agency works with clients in thirty different countries, so don't panic."
options: The senior translator told the intern that their agency worked with clients in thirty countries and advised him not to panic.
The senior translator said the intern that their agency worked with clients in thirty countries and advised him to not panic.
The senior translator told the intern that our agency works with clients in thirty countries and advised him don't panic.
The senior translator asked the intern if their agency worked with clients in thirty countries and warned him not to panic.
explanation_ru: Только первый вариант верно передаёт обе части высказывания: утверждение через told + объект + сдвиг времени и совет через конструкцию advise + объект + not to-инфинитив.

prompt: The manager in Athens stayed quiet. Earlier, two part-time workers had suggested to move the phone shop to a busier street.
answer: The manager in Athens stayed quiet. Earlier, two part-time workers had suggested moving the phone shop to a busier street.
accepted_answers: The manager in Athens stayed quiet. Earlier, two part-time workers had suggested moving the phone shop to a busier street.
The manager in Athens stayed quiet. Earlier, two part-time workers had suggested that they move the phone shop to a busier street.
The manager in Athens stayed quiet. Earlier, two part-time workers had suggested that they should move the phone shop to a busier street.
The manager in Athens stayed quiet. Earlier, two part-time workers had suggested that the phone shop move to a busier street.
The manager in Athens stayed quiet. Earlier, two part-time workers had suggested that the phone shop should move to a busier street.
The manager in Athens stayed quiet. Earlier, two part-time workers had suggested that they moved the phone shop to a busier street.
explanation_ru: После глагола suggest нельзя ставить инфинитив с to (suggested to move — частая ошибка). Верно использовать герундий (suggested moving) или придаточное с that.

prompt: No official announcement had been made at the Valencia port. Even so, one passenger insisted, "The ship will not leave until the storm passes." → Although no announcement had been made at the Valencia port, one passenger insisted …
answer: Although no announcement had been made at the Valencia port, one passenger insisted that the ship would not leave until the storm passed.
accepted_answers: Although no announcement had been made at the Valencia port, one passenger insisted that the ship would not leave until the storm passed.
Although no announcement had been made at the Valencia port, one passenger insisted the ship would not leave until the storm passed.
Although no announcement had been made at the Valencia port, one passenger insisted that the ship wouldn't leave until the storm passed.
Although no announcement had been made at the Valencia port, one passenger insisted the ship wouldn't leave until the storm passed.
explanation_ru: После глагола insisted в прошедшем времени will not сдвигается в would not, а глагол в придаточном времени после until переходит из Present Simple в Past Simple (passed).

prompt: In Copenhagen, an airport assistant reminded the tired family that the train station was directly under that building and they did not need a taxi. → The assistant said to the family, …
answer: The assistant said to the family, "The train station is directly under this building, and you don't need a taxi."
accepted_answers: The assistant said to the family, "The train station is directly under this building, and you don't need a taxi."
The assistant said to the family, "The train station is directly under this building and you don't need a taxi."
The assistant said to the family, "The train station is directly under this building, and you do not need a taxi."
The assistant said to the family, "The train station is directly under this building and you do not need a taxi."
explanation_ru: При возвращении в прямую речь меняются время (was → is, did not need → don't need), указательное слово (that building → this building) и местоимение (they → you).

prompt: Two nervous tourists stood at the Rio de Janeiro cable car station. Before buying tickets, they asked the conductor whether did the cable car really run to the top every day.
answer: Two nervous tourists stood at the Rio de Janeiro cable car station. Before buying tickets, they asked the conductor whether the cable car really ran to the top every day.
accepted_answers: Two nervous tourists stood at the Rio de Janeiro cable car station. Before buying tickets, they asked the conductor whether the cable car really ran to the top every day.
Two nervous tourists stood at the Rio de Janeiro cable car station. Before buying tickets, they asked the conductor whether the cable car really runs to the top every day.
Two nervous tourists stood at the Rio de Janeiro cable car station. Before buying tickets, they asked the conductor if the cable car really ran to the top every day.
Two nervous tourists stood at the Rio de Janeiro cable car station. Before buying tickets, they asked the conductor if the cable car really runs to the top every day.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе после whether или if не используется вспомогательный глагол did: нужен прямой порядок слов (whether the cable car really ran / runs).

prompt: Halfway through a tournament in Reykjavik, a chess club member leaned over and whispered to me, "If the visiting champion plays white, he never loses."
options: The club member whispered me that if the visiting champion played white, he would never lose.
The club member whispered to me that if the visiting champion played white, he never lost.
The club member whispered to me whether if the visiting champion played white, he never lost.
The club member whispered to me that if the visiting champion will play white, he never loses.
explanation_ru: После глагола whisper адресат вводится с предлогом to (whispered to me), а условное предложение нулевого типа сдвигается в Past Simple в обеих частях без will после if.

prompt: The phone shop worker promised me my screen ___ ready by Friday evening.
explanation_ru: Модальный глагол should в косвенной речи не изменяется и употребляется без частицы to, тогда как will и is после promised в прошлом требуют сдвига времени.
